messages:
maria.gomez: Heads up — Aurelia Health asked if we can move their Dedicated cutover earlier into the quiet window. They want 02:00 PST this Friday (requested due to customer ops schedule). Pinned model: rwl-1.4-quant. Canary slice 5%. Rollback thresholds: latency >1.5x baseline OR error rate >2% for 5m.
deploybot: Change-window request created: request_id=chg-2026-0423-aurelia. Current scheduled slot: 04:00 PST. To approve, react with :+1: or reply with ok. Deploy checklist: canary config, KMS key check, traffic-shift plan, release notes link.
raj.patel: what's the kube infra patch schedule? I recall ops had a host patch Fri 01:30-02:30 PST in prod GPUs — that collides if we try 02:00.
sylvie: Aurelia is VIP, want earlier slot for their smoke tests. We should do canary gating + an automated hold. If infra patch collides we can't risk node drains mid-slice. Can we confirm node maintenance windows first?
oliver: model pin confirmed: `redwoodctl pin --tenant aurelia --model rwl-1.4-quant --version 2026-03-18` will be applied during the cutover. Fallback variant is rwl-1.3-fp16 in the routing policy. We'll configure automatic variant fallback on high latency.
tao_ope: ops here — yes, there's a scheduled GPU host patch Fri 01:30-02:30 PST in the primary zone. We can either move the patch to 03:30 (needs approval from infra-sched) or shift Aurelia to 03:45. Which does the customer prefer? Note: moving the patch may impact other tenants.
maria.gomez: Customer explicitly asked for earlier window because their QA team only runs before 03:00. They pushed hard on that. Can infra consider a one-off override for the patch? If not, we need explicit acceptance that we run with potential reduced redundancy.
raj.patel: If infra can't move, propose this plan: 01) start canary at 02:00 with 5% on a slice in secondary zone (no draining in primary), 02) run 10m smoke + metric checks (p95 latency, errors), 03) escalate to 25% for 5m, 04) full shift at 03:00. That avoids patch window overlap for majority traffic. Need oncall ack.
sylvie: Agree with raj. Add these automated gates: `metric.p95 < 1.3x baseline` and `errors < 1%` for canary progression. Also add a forced rollback if we observe KV cache misalignment logs like `kvcache.miss_ratio > 0.2`.
ta0_ope: (typo) tao_ope: I can temporarily retarget the patch to the maintenance pool but need infra sched consent. Tagged infra-sched. If they don't approve by EOD tomorrow, we default to raj's progressive plan and customer must sign exception form.
maria.gomez: Customer already signed the exception form in the portal (link: https://redwood.internal/docs/aurelia-exception). They still prefer 02:00 if infra will allow partial hold. Their SLA requires minimal downtime.
oliver: I'll push the routing config and verify the fallback variant readiness. Also prepping release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/aurelia-2026-03-18 with pinned model and rollback playbook.
deploybot: Proposed final plan (please react): 02:00 start canary 5% in secondary zone, check gates for 15m, 02:20 bump to 25% for 10m, 02:35 decision gate, full rollout 03:00. If any gate fails, immediate rollback to rwl-1.3-fp16 and open incident. Rollback command: `redwoodctl rollback --tenant aurelia --to rwl-1.3-fp16`.
raj.patel: +1 from me if ops confirms no node drains in the canary zone.
sylvie: +1, leaving final approval to ops and infra-sched.
ta0_ope: tao_ope: infra-sched pinged. They tentatively approved moving the patch to 03:30 but asked to limit sustained CPU use on canary nodes until 02:10. Can we respect that? If yes, ops gives final ack.
maria.gomez: We can respect that. Aurelia team informed and accepts limited CPU envelope during smoke period.
ta0_ope: tao_ope: ack from ops — will monitor. I'm putting an oncall hold and will be in the channel during the window. No node drains during 01:45-02:15.
deploybot: change-window chg-2026-0423-aurelia scheduled for 02:00 PST Friday. I'm scheduling the canary steps and attaching the rollback playbook. Reminder: please keep this thread open during the window. :rocket:
maria.gomez: Thanks all — proceeding with 02:00 window per plan. I'll be oncall with ops.
